svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Trash of managed projects: delete to the trash, restore, permanent delete, the 30-day sweep and crash recovery
svg.desc: Only a managed project's folder goes to the trash, only with the typed id. The delete writes a pending sidecar, renames the folder into the entry, updates the list and marks the sidecar trashed, all under the project lock. Restore renames it back; Delete permanently and the sweep remove the entry audit-first; a pending entry a crash left is settled under the project lock by the listing, restore, purge and the sweep. Audit points are marked.
svg.text: DELETE (DELETE /projects/{id}/files, typed id, under the project lock)
CRASH RECOVERY (_settle_pending, under the project lock: a pending sidecar seen there is a crash's)
crash before 2 (no project/ folder): the entry is removed, the project untouched
crash between 2 and 3 (the list names the vanished original): set_trashed, then trashed - the confirmed delete is completed
crash between 3 and 4 (the list names this entry): trashed; anything else: trashed (Restore answers as for any entry)
who settles: the listing (lock wait 0.2 s, busy -> stays pending), Restore, Delete permanently, the sweep (1 s)
audit project.deleted recovered BEFORE the list or the entry changes
THE TRASH (GET /projects/-/trash, newest first, pages of 200: offset, limit, total, next_offset)
